community_searchSearchEmptyEmptyMessage2.en: Type at least {searchMinimumRunes} characters to search
community_searchSearchEmptyEmptyMessage2.zh: 输入至少 {searchMinimumRunes} 个字符开始搜索

community_searchSearchEmptyEmptyReason2.en: Search matches from the start and shows only discoverable accounts and verified communities.
community_searchSearchEmptyEmptyReason2.zh: 搜索按开头匹配，只显示允许被搜到的账号与已验证的社区。

community_searchSearchEmptyMessage.en: Try another keyword or switch the category above
community_searchSearchEmptyMessage.zh: 换个关键词，或切换上面的分类试试

community_voiceRoomOpenMessage2.en: This community already has a live voice room, so no new one was created. Refresh to enter.
community_voiceRoomOpenMessage2.zh: 这个社区已经有进行中的语音房，没有重复创建。请刷新后进入。

community_widgetsBoundAssetKey.en: Needs a 40-character hex contract address, optionally prefixed with {chainId}:.
community_widgetsBoundAssetKey.zh: 需要 40 位十六进制合约地址，可带 {chainId}: 前缀。

community_widgetsCommunityApplicationPen.en: Mining weight and the official group open after approval. Until it's verified, this community has no verified badge.
community_widgetsCommunityApplicationPen.zh: 通过后开放挖矿权重与官方群。运维核验前，这个社区不带验证标记。

community_widgetsCommunityApplicationPro.en: Check review progress under Me → My communities → Created.
community_widgetsCommunityApplicationPro.zh: 可以在「我的 → 我的社区 → 我创建的」查看审核进度。

community_widgetsCommunityApplicationRej.en: No reason was given. Edit the community profile and resubmit.
community_widgetsCommunityApplicationRej.zh: 运维没有给出原因。修改社区资料后可以重新提交。

community_widgetsCommunityBoundAssetChai.en: Just enter the contract address. {name} is filled in for you.
community_widgetsCommunityBoundAssetChai.zh: 只填合约地址即可，将按 {name} 补全。

community_widgetsCommunityPreviewNoticeB.en: {resource} exists only in this development preview. It isn't saved to your account or uploaded.
community_widgetsCommunityPreviewNoticeB.zh: {resource}只存在于这次开发预览里，不会写入账号，也不会上传。

community_widgetsCommunityRejectedReason.zh: 驳回：运维没有给出原因

community_widgetsCommunityStateUnavailab.en: This feature isn't available right now

community_widgetsDescription.en: The bio can be up to 280 characters with no control characters.
community_widgetsDescription.zh: 简介最多 280 个字符，且不能包含控制字符。

community_widgetsHint.en: Short link: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
community_widgetsHint.zh: 短链接，小写字母、数字与连字符

community_widgetsLabelText3.zh: 绑定代币（仅所有者，可留空）

community_widgetsLoopSheetHeading.zh: 这里数的是连接，不是活跃

community_widgetsLoopSheetHeading2.zh: 申请已提交 · 审核中

community_widgetsMiningCommunityWeightAp.en: Granted after review and included in the figure above
community_widgetsMiningCommunityWeightAp.zh: 已按审核结果授予，算在上面的数里

community_widgetsMiningCommunityWeightPe.en: Weight is still in review, so no value is shown
community_widgetsMiningCommunityWeightPe.zh: 权重还在审核中，这里不显示数值

community_widgetsMiningCommunityWeightPe.en: No linked token, so there's no weight to review
community_widgetsMiningCommunityWeightPe.zh: 没有绑定代币，没有权重可审

community_widgetsMiningParticipantsCount.en: People with power in the latest power snapshot
community_widgetsMiningParticipantsCount.zh: 最近一次算力快照里算出了算力的人

community_widgetsMiningParticipantsUnava.en: This item can't be loaded right now

community_widgetsName.en: The name needs 1–40 characters with no control characters.
community_widgetsName.zh: 名称需要 1–40 个字符，且不能包含控制字符。

community_widgetsS.en: Chain status isn't loaded yet. If you enter only the address, {name} is filled in.
community_widgetsS.zh: 暂未取到链状态，只填地址时将按 {name} 补全。

community_widgetsSemantic.en: Community mining panel, weight {weight}, community power {power}
community_widgetsSemantic.zh: 社区挖矿面板，权重 {weight}，社区算力 {power}

community_widgetsShowCommunityApplicatio.en: "{communityName}" is in the review queue and you're its owner. {communityApplicationProgressHint} The verified badge, mining weight and official group appear after approval.
community_widgetsShowCommunityApplicatio.zh: 「{communityName}」已进入审核队列，你是它的所有者。{communityApplicationProgressHint}通过后才会显示验证标记，并开放挖矿权重与官方群。

community_widgetsShowCommunityPresenceMe.en: This is how many members of the community's official channel are connected to Stream right now ({communityCountLabel}). It isn't "watching this channel", "recently active", or the total member count. It's a single observation, not a running count.
community_widgetsShowCommunityPresenceMe.zh: 这是社区官方频道的成员里，此刻仍与 Stream 保持连接的人数（{communityCountLabel} 人），不是「正在看这个频道」，不是「最近活跃」，也不是社区成员总数。它是一次观察，不是持续统计。

community_widgetsSlug.en: The short link must be 3–32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
community_widgetsSlug.zh: 短链接只能是 3–32 位小写字母、数字或连字符。

community_widgetsSwitch2.en: Formula version {identifier} used by this power snapshot
community_widgetsSwitch2.zh: 这次算力快照所用的公式版本 {identifier}

community_widgetsText.en: {communityBoundAssetChainNote}{communityBoundAssetUniqueHint} After you submit it goes into review and you're the owner. The verified badge is set after verification.
community_widgetsText.zh: {communityBoundAssetChainNote}{communityBoundAssetUniqueHint}提交后进入审核，你是所有者；验证标记由运维核验后设置。
